heading: This Afternoon
text: Variable clouds and sun, with a few periods of localized showers. Winds increasing, and remaining cool  Highs in the 50s north, 60 to 65 south. Winds becoming west to northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 30 to 40 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any stray evening showers north tapering off. Periods of clouds in the northern mountains, with clearing in the Champlain and St. Lawrence Valleys, and south. Blustery and colder. Lows in the 30s, near 30 over the higher terrain north. Winds northwest 10 to 20 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly sunny, except morning clouds through the northern mountains giving way to increasing afternoon sun. Breezy and chilly. Highs only in the upper 40s to low 50s north, in the 50s south. Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 25 to 35 mph.
